skins.name: Bard's Holiday
skins.description: Trendy autumn attire, loose and breathable. Incorporates a unique multi-layer pocket design, convenient for holding all sorts of lightweight souvenirs during a serendipitous sojourn.

skins.name: Glory Purple
skins.description: Zofia's attire when she participated in the Kazimierz Major awards ceremony. The right choice of attire made her the center of attention during the ceremony.

skins.name: Cleansweeper in the Castle
skins.code: Multimedia Escape Experience "Dreambind Castle" Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Cleansweeper in the Castle
skins.description: The outfit Shaw wore for the investigation event "Trails in the Castle." While Shaw trawls the castle scenery, she's prepared to fend off unexpected guests at any time.

skins.name: Dream Within a Dreammare
skins.code: Multimedia Escape Experience "Dreambind Castle" Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Dream Within a Dreammare
skins.description: Clothes of Phantom's, the attire he sported while staffing the "Dreambind Castle" event. The dance as cloth, the song as silk, the threading through emotion, the tailoring by fabrication, the weave of obliteration and howling madness, it all culminates in this majestic yet skin-crawling ensemble.

skins.name: Exterminator in the Square
skins.code: Multimedia Escape Experience "Dreambind Castle" Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Exterminator in the Square
skins.description: The outfit Glaucus wore for the photoshoot event "Cyclonic Square." Prior to the photographer clicking the shutter, Glaucus needed to nail down her pose.

skins.name: Visionblazer in the Courtyard
skins.code: Multimedia Escape Experience "Dreambind Castle" Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Visionblazer in the Courtyard
skins.description: The outfit Mayer wore for the code-cracking event "Courtyard Tidings." Mayer loved all the puzzles her coworkers designed, and took to making short work of them.
